inputs: Reuse only the pinned floor preflight's eleven matched historical items, six scalar arms and five native-scale repeat values. No floor bootstrap, human target, band, prose, rationale, native or judge rerun.
timing: Retrospective diagnostic; prior variation, rank correlation, floor/tie, scalar-direction, rater sensitivity and calibration results known before this profile; freeze before these new explicit reversal counts.
cohorts: Original six items/six prompts and later five items/four prompts remain separate; all six arms share cohort membership; never pool HBQ versions or estimate a version effect.
arithmetic: Exact Fraction conversion of inherited JSON decimal score tokens; compare signs with no rounding, epsilon, mean aggregation, normalization or clipping.
repeat_index: Positions one through five of the frozen saved score arrays. Index alignment is the registered repeat position, not synchronized wall-clock judging or independent provider control attestation.
pair_orientation: Lexicographically sorted item IDs within each cohort; sign of first-item score minus second-item score at each registered repeat. Swapping orientation swaps positive/negative but preserves pair categories and disagreement rates.

categories.strict_reversal: At least one positive and one negative sign among five repeats, with or without ties
categories.stable_strict: All five signs are positive or all five negative
categories.tie_changing_no_reversal: At least one zero and exactly one nonzero sign direction; ties change but no strict reversal

metrics.primary: Number of item pairs with any strict reversal, out of all 15 original or 10 later pairs per arm; four mutually exclusive exhaustive categories
metrics.secondary: Three-by-three sign cross-tab over each pair's ten registered repeat-index combinations, earlier index rows/later index columns in order negative, tie, positive. This is not temporal causality or packet-order perturbation.
metrics.strict_flip_rate: Opposite nonzero sign comparison count divided by all pair-repeat comparisons, 150 original or 100 later per arm
metrics.conditional_strict_flip_rate: Opposite nonzero sign comparisons divided by comparisons where both signs are nonzero; undefined null at zero denominator, not zero reliability error
metrics.tie_change_comparisons: Exactly one sign is zero; separate from strict flips and equal signs
metrics.prompt_strata: Report same-prompt and different-prompt item pairs separately as descriptive inventories; original has zero same-prompt pairs, later one. Do not interpret different-prompt ordering as validated quality ranking.

missingness: Fail closed on changed pins, missing score or unmatched arm/item/repeat/cohort; no complete-case omission.
publication: Aggregate counts, exact rates, cohort/source commitments only; exact pair membership, score vectors and sign sequences remain private.
interpretation: Tiny previously opened dependent historical panel. Item pairs share works/prompts and repeat-index comparisons share scores. No CI, significance, independent trial, leaf/chance-adjusted agreement, interendpoint result, human alignment, contemporary tools-disabled qualification, version causality or promotion. Stable all-tied scores are not discrimination.
